{
  "assessments": [
    {
      "clause_id": "k1",
      "rule_id": "R01",
      "verdict": "compliant",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "evidence": "This agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the substantive laws applicable within the jurisdiction of our principal headquarters.",
      "reason": "This is a general governing law clause that does not restrict or violate data subject consent rights under the PDPL."
    },
    {
      "clause_id": "k3",
      "rule_id": "R05",
      "verdict": "compliant",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "evidence": "All intellectual property rights, including trademarks, source code, graphics, and proprietary software, remain the sole and exclusive property of Al-Noor Digital Services.",
      "reason": "This clause deals strictly with intellectual property rights and does not affect data subject rights."
    },
    {
      "clause_id": "k4",
      "rule_id": "R02",
      "verdict": "compliant",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "evidence": "For the purposes of this document, the term Service shall refer exclusively to the software platform, digital tools, and associated web interfaces provided by the company.",
      "reason": "This is a definition clause that defines the scope of the service and does not expand data processing purposes unlawfully."
    },
    {
      "clause_id": "k6",
      "rule_id": "R07",
      "verdict": "compliant",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "evidence": "Al-Noor Digital Services shall not be held liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the temporary unavailability of the platform due to scheduled maintenance.",
      "reason": "This clause limits liability for platform downtime and does not waive statutory breach notification obligations."
    },
    {
      "clause_id": "k7",
      "rule_id": "R01",
      "verdict": "compliant",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "evidence": "Either party may terminate the service agreement with thirty days written notice, provided that all outstanding financial balances have been settled in full.",
      "reason": "This is a standard contract termination clause and does not restrict the withdrawal of personal data consent."
    },
    {
      "clause_id": "k8",
      "rule_id": "R11",
      "verdict": "compliant",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "evidence": "Promotional offers and awareness materials are transmitted to personal contact channels solely upon receiving the explicit prior consent of the recipient",
      "reason": "The clause explicitly requires prior consent and provides an easy opt-out mechanism for direct marketing, fully complying with PDPL Article 25."
    }
  ]
}

assessments.reason: This clause limits liability for platform downtime and does not waive statutory breach notification obligations.
